english.title: Operate international bus or coach service when vehicle registered elsewhere
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) operated a

(A)_[regular]_
(B)_[special regular]_

passenger transport service using a bus or coach, namely **(..SPECIFY MAKE AND REG..) that was registered in a country other than that in which you were established or resided, namely **(..SPECIFY WHERE REGISTERED..), in breach of Article 475(8) of the RPT Chapter
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(1)(c) and 18 of the Road Transport (International Passenger Services) Regulations 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
